difference_definition: alpha2 minus alpha1, separately for each pair and feature
ratio_definition: alpha1 Ki / alpha2 Ki; positive finite exact values with same endpoint, unit and recorded context only
efficacy_ratio_policy: Withhold: percent-change normalization and experimental concentration are not established; retain percentage-point difference only
structural_policy: Use receptor-specific corrected mapping; audit contact counts against raw PLIP and all nine recorded poses; missing evidence stays null
existing_files_policy: Never modify prior runs, source data, or LATEST_RUN.txt
